test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 8% per annum compounded annually is Rs. 416. What is the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for the same period?
solution:
Given:

The compound interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 8% per annum compounded annually is Rs. 416.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Calculation:

Let the sum be Rs. Q.

According to the question,

Q(1 + 8/100)² - Q = 416

⇒ 0.1664Q = 416

⇒ Q = 416/0.1664

⇒ Q = 2500

Now, the simple interest on Rs. 2500 for 2 years at 8% per annum

⇒ (2500 × 8 × 2)/1000 = Rs. 400

**∴ Rs. 400 is the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for the same period.**
